datasets.title: IGAD Region - Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) 2020
datasets.description: Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-monthly-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2020]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Monthly CDI rasters were generated by ICPAC using the East Africa Drought Watch methodology, which combines multiple drought indicators (meteorological, agricultural, hydrological) into a single composite index to detect and monitor drought-affected areas across the IGAD region. The dataset provides 12 monthly snapshots for 2020 as GeoTIFF rasters.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator methodology that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought indicators into a unified monitoring index
